options.name: config_AM_globalStats_enable
options.description: If true, landice analysis member globalStats is called.

options.name: config_AM_globalStats_compute_interval
options.description: Timestamp determining how often analysis member computations should be performed.

options.name: config_AM_globalStats_stream_name
options.description: Name of the stream that the globalStats analysis member should be tied to.

options.name: config_AM_globalStats_compute_on_startup
options.description: Logical flag determining if analysis member computations occur on start-up.

options.name: config_AM_globalStats_write_on_startup
options.description: Logical flag determining if an analysis member write occurs on start-up.
